item.title: Staying classy, Anchorman's Will Ferrell and Adam McKay paid Christina Applegate from own salaries
item.description: After an "offensive" initial offer, Anchorman co-writers Will Ferrell and Adam McKay eased the pain by giving Christina Applegate money out of their wallets.

item.title: 12 new albums to stream this week
item.description: The new albums from Sturgill Simpson, OHYUNG, Scout Gillett, and Bory should be at the top of your queue today. Tap in and find a new obsession.

item.title: The Best Paste Party Ever daily schedule is here
item.description: Our free four-day extravaganza is set for March 14-17 in Austin, featuring 32 great artists, activations, celebrity interviews, and more.

item.title: Nintendo sues U.S. government over all the tariffs it just had to pay on those Switch 2s
item.description: Nintendo launched its new Switch 2 console just as Donald Trump's tariffs were rolling out; they'd like that money back now, please.

item.title: It's Sinners versus everybody else in the latest stack of anonymous Oscar ballots
item.description: Ryan Coogler's film seems to be the movie that people are either voting for, or against, in the latest report on nameless Oscar ballots.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino puts off 10th movie to develop British farce for the stage
item.description: After gifting his 10th and final film to David Fincher, Quentin Tarantino is trading the big screen for the stage floor.
